function.name: read_file
function.description: Reads and returns the content of a specified file. If the file is large, the content will be truncated.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to read.

offset.description: The line number to start reading from (0-based).

limit.description: The maximum number of lines to read.

function.name: run_shell_command
function.description: Executes a given shell command in a subprocess.
